output.summary: Aloe is a genus of flowering succulents native to tropical and southern Africa, Madagascar, Jordan, the Arabian Peninsula, India and islands of the Indian Ocean. Most have rosettes of thick, fleshy leaves and clusters of tubular flowers that are often yellow, orange, pink or red; some South African aloes grow as trees.
output.edibilityNote: Some species are edible, but many species have irritating or harmful juice or latex.
